verdict.rationale: Recruitee is an ATS/recruiting SaaS platform, not an AI agent; the evidence pack shows only REST APIs, webhooks, and integrations with no mention of MCP servers or agent tool-plugging capability. This axis concerns whether a product can consume MCP servers as an agent client, which is a category error for a recruiting SaaS platform of this kind—no evidence suggests it functions as or connects to MCP-compatible agent tooling.
